title: UNI Physics students present at international conference
summary_en: Four undergraduate students from the UNI Department of Physics presented their work at the 71st Annual Conference on Magnetism and Magnetic Materials in Hawaii. The conference brings together thousands of researchers, educators and students from around the world to share the latest scientific discoveries and technological advances.
